The '''1989 1. divisjon''' was the 45th completed season of top division [[association football|football]] in [[Norway]]. The season began on 30 April 1989, and ended on 8 October 1989.

22 games were played with 3 points given for wins and 1 for draws. Number eleven and twelve were relegated. The winners of the two groups of the [[1. divisjon|2. divisjon]] were promoted, as well as the winner of a series of play-off matches between the two second placed teams in the two groups of the 2. divisjon and number ten in the 1. divisjon.

This was the last season the top flight of Norwegian football would be called the 1. divisjon. The following year, the league changed its name to Tippeligaen, from its sponsor, [[Norsk Tipping]].<ref name=Tippeligaen1>{{cite news |title=Tippemillionene |last=Johansen |first=Magne |work=[[Aftenposten]] |language=Norwegian |date=October 26, 1989 |page=35 }}</ref>
